status: DRAFT - not registered; amended 2026-10-26 (router designed on wide and evaluated once on core, evidence anchors, K and KS); values stay proposals until the core registration (see open_decisions)

copy_target.order: only after audit-report.json is final; amended 2026-10-27: protocol.json itself is not edited, because its SHA-256 binds the review page, review import, adjudication and the draft keys, and the pilot content hash is part of every campaign manifest; the controls file names that SHA-256

verified_endpoint.weights: Q4_K_M quantization served by llama.cpp; Regime B-style weights, recorded as a threat to validity
verified_endpoint.evidence: one ping, 24 timing probes and 144 synthetic prompt-development requests; every response carried the same model id (synthetic-dev-results.md)
verified_endpoint.access: IEC VPN via OpenVPN 3 profile member-shared-tcp; llmapi.iec resolved inside the runner process through the tunnel DNS 172.16.30.1 (172.16.50.172); no system resolver or hosts change
verified_endpoint.reverify: ping and model-id check immediately before each execute; the runner pauses on a model-id change

versioned_vietnamese_corpus.decision: corpus v0 in the first core registration if it passes tasks 7.2 and 7.3; otherwise none, and arms K and KS are registered later under their own card
versioned_vietnamese_corpus.scope: full texts of the documents the reviewer cited for the evidence anchors plus distractor documents, chunked by article; scoped by the audit, so arm K measures article retrieval in a corpus known to hold the relevant documents, not open-domain retrieval
versioned_vietnamese_corpus.checks: no benchmark question, option, answer or model output in the corpus; provenance (source URL, retrieval time, SHA-256) per document; hashed retrieval configuration; share of cited articles in the top k measured once, misses listed, configuration unchanged afterwards
versioned_vietnamese_corpus.oracle_evidence: arm O uses reviewer-cited provisions whose hash is recorded as evidence_sha256
versioned_vietnamese_corpus.k_ks_status: included in the first core registration if the checks pass (decided 2026-10-26)

hard_runtime_budget.basis: 2026-10-22 probes: about 244 output tokens and 5 s per attempt (B 2-8 tokens, S up to 1,551); expected total about 2 M tokens for core plus wide; the cap is a guard, not an estimate
hard_runtime_budget.enforced_by: runner budget guard: pauses without further requests once cumulative reported tokens reach the cap

augmentation_model_and_controls.model: Qwen3.5-9B-65K via the endpoint above, one model for every arm
augmentation_model_and_controls.controls: identical sampling, output cap and system prompt for every arm; S changes only the instruction and adds no information; O and K prepend one frozen evidence block (same template) to the B prompt and KS to the S prompt; item-major scheduling keeps the arms of one item adjacent in time

runtime_verification_policy.reason: runtime verifier is future work; no verifier in the core campaign

arms.O: frozen evidence block of reviewer-cited provisions plus the B prompt
arms.K: frozen evidence block of retrieved provisions (corpus v0) plus the B prompt
arms.KS: the same retrieved evidence block plus the S prompt

phases.core: 60 audit anchors, 3 replicates; arms B and S on every anchor; O, K and KS on the evidence anchors (Legal MC, adjudicated input insufficient and gold valid)
phases.wide: 1,239 non-anchor items, 1 replicate, arms B and S

campaign_controls.transport: direct OpenAI Responses API, streaming, temperature 1.0, no seed, no reasoning field, 300 s timeout, no SDK retries, 12 workers
campaign_controls.scorers: frozen V1 scorers for B, O and K; final-segment rule diagnostic-final-segment-v1 for S and KS

split_manifest.router_design: wide: the 1,239 non-anchor items of the same five datasets, whose B and S outcomes (MC-90 to MC-92) were unblinded on 2026-10-22; candidate rules are fitted here and their wide figures are design fit only
split_manifest.router_evaluation: core: the 60 audit anchors, which no prospective request has reached; the frozen rule is evaluated once
split_manifest.grouping: reading items grouped by passage_id; all arms and replicates of an item stay in one split
split_manifest.caveat: every item was answered by earlier runs and the anchors were audited: core is unseen for the prospective arms and conditions only, and audit fields are forbidden router features
split_manifest.amended: 2026-10-26 (design.md Decision 11): design and evaluation roles swapped; the earlier draft tuned on core and evaluated once on wide

future_experiment_contract.corpus_version: corpus v0 if it passes tasks 7.2 and 7.3 (see readiness_controls.versioned_vietnamese_corpus); none otherwise

budget_policy.currency_or_token_accounting: tokens as reported by the endpoint (input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens); no currency because the IEC tariff is not declared

replicate_pairing_and_stability.pairing_rule: paired by item within a phase; an arm's item outcome is the strict majority of its replicates (core) or its single attempt (wide); a tie counts as incorrect and is reported
replicate_pairing_and_stability.stable_recovery_threshold: rescue under the majority rule: B majority incorrect (at most 1 of 3 correct) and the arm majority correct (at least 2 of 3)

action_policy.quality_threshold: multiple choice: exact letter; reading: exact match; token-F1 at least 0.8 with exact match 0 is listed as a semantic-audit candidate and never counted as success
action_policy.ties: among successful arms prefer lower mean total tokens, then lower mean latency

comparisons: matched prospective B, S, O, K and KS attempts inside one core campaign
B versus S on the wide set (MC-90 to MC-92, done)
oracle and retrieved evidence versus baseline on the evidence anchors
oracle versus retrieved evidence on the same anchors (retrieval isolated from evidence need)
rule router versus always-B, always-S and the best fixed arm on core

deployment_comparisons.always-K: evidence anchors only, descriptive (core arm analysis)
deployment_comparisons.always-KS: evidence anchors only, descriptive (core arm analysis)
deployment_comparisons.best-fixed-from-dev: included: B or S, whichever has the higher mean accuracy over its two wide draws, recorded with the rule and evaluated once on core
deployment_comparisons.rule-router: included: designed on wide, frozen by SHA-256 in the core registration before the first core request, evaluated once on core

diagnostic_contrasts.retriever_vs_assembly_vs_generator: partial in v1: O versus K on the same evidence anchors (descriptive); assembly and generator contrasts not run

future_experiment_contract.runtime_goal: predict quality and cost and choose an arm under remaining budget; causal diagnosis is a separate offline analysis
future_experiment_contract.request_accounting: core: 360 B and S attempts plus three replicates of each evidence arm (O; K and KS if registered) per evidence anchor; wide: 2,478 plus 1,239 for each supplement (MC-91, MC-92); each attempt is one model request and technical retries are visible in the attempt ledger
future_experiment_contract.reporting: AI-assisted primary versus blind human agreement must not be described as two blind human raters

card_ids.core: MC-NN (next free id at core registration; MC-93 on 2026-10-26)
card_ids.wide: MC-90 (REGISTERED 2026-10-22, see docs/measurement_cards/MC-90-diagnostic-prospective-wide.md); supplements MC-91 and MC-92

fixed_in: data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/protocol.json -> analysis (metric names are checked against the analysis code by a test)

router.rule: router-c1-drop-s: Vi-DROP items to S (targets reasoning_gap, reading_representation_gap), every other item to B; sha256 8140c13eade80cbaa5f3b0e7f14cbba88caa547c844df014de1d5f35a845b292, byte-identical to router_candidates/c1-drop-s.json; best fixed arm S (wide two-draw mean S 53.15, B 50.36)
router.rule_file: data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/router_v1.json; its SHA-256 and the best fixed arm go into the core registration entry and card
router.must_be_written_before: the first core request: core --execute refuses to start without the rule file or with another hash
router.chosen_by: the project owner, from two or three candidate rules fitted on wide
runtime_features_allowed: length in characters of the frozen B prompt
case-insensitive literal cue words in the question text
forbidden_features: audit fields (diagnostic labels, gold validity, evidence sufficiency)
router.not_selectable: O: reviewer-cited provisions do not exist at request time; a ceiling only
router.evaluation_set: core anchors whose manifest contains the arm the rule selects for them; excluded anchors are listed
router.tests: exact two-sided McNemar of the router against always-B and against always-S, Holm over the two; Wilson intervals for accuracy
router.ceilings: ceiling over the deployable arms available per item next to the ceiling over B replicates (oracle_routing definition, O left out)
router.cost: mean reported total tokens per item for each policy; unreported usage is unknown, not zero
router.sensitivity: secondary: the same comparisons without anchors whose adjudicated gold is not valid
router.targets: every condition and the default declare the audit-taxonomy labels the routed arm is meant to address (S: reasoning_gap, reading_representation_gap; K: external_evidence_gap, parametric_knowledge_gap, parametric_knowledge_error; KS: their union; B: none); declarations only, never routing inputs
router.cue_lexicon: cue words come from a lexicon grouped by need (calculation or combination of facts; legal provisions outside the input), hashed before any cue-level wide outcome is computed: data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/cue_lexicon_v1.json, sha256 59e749b863687c22d5ff87a68179a95238b6ad1703a9c339a2be939446e82692; a condition may test only cues of a group that shares one of its targets; candidates committed with it in data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/router_candidates/
router.design_fit_semantic: for reading items of the first wide draw pair, the exact-match rescues and regressions of each routed group and how many the semantic review found to be measurement effects
router.detection: descriptive: anchors with at least one adjudicated hypothesis that the router sent to an arm targeting one of them (total and per label), and no-issue anchors sent to an arm other than B; labels from the anchor-diagnosis file whose SHA-256 is registered
router.amended: 2026-10-26 (design.md Decision 11); targets, lexicon, semantic design fit and detection 2026-10-27 (Decision 12)

analysis_plan.oracle_routing: reported only with the ceiling over B replicates alone; on wide (one draw per arm) no noise floor exists and the ceiling is not read as headroom
analysis_plan.noise_reference: core: attempt-level rescue and regression between B replicates, shown next to each arm's attempt-level rates; wide: unavailable (one draw)
analysis_plan.parity_gate: wide only: B per dataset must lie inside the MC-83 interval (Legal MC 76.70-88.70, Legal NLI 85.74-94.87, Vi-SQuAD EM 69.59-81.50, Vi-DROP EM 41.09-55.05, ViBidLQA EM 24.05-31.58) before any effect is interpreted
analysis_plan.power_note: the multiple-choice family has only about thirty B-incorrect items on wide: a null result there is reported as insufficient power, not as no effect
analysis_plan.recovery_by_hypothesis: core, descriptive, a separate registered analysis: anchors grouped by adjudicated hypothesis plus no-issue, unresolved and empty-hypothesis groups; B-incorrect anchors, per-arm rescues, regressions and anchors no arm answers; contrast candidates for a reviewer (never an automatic upgrade to contrast_supported); issue anchors whose new B majority is correct reported as not reproduced (design.md Decision 12)

open_decisions: DECIDED 2026-10-22 by the project owner: core replicates = 3; the defaults of the remaining items were accepted ('OK') unless a later message says otherwise
campaign cap of 5,000,000 tokens and output cap of 4,096 for every arm and dataset
stable-recovery rule: strict majority of replicates
tie-break among successful arms: fewer mean total tokens, then lower mean latency
reading correctness: exact match, with token-F1 >= 0.8 listed for audit but not counted
SUPERSEDED 2026-10-26 (see below): arms K and KS excluded from the first registration and registered later under a separate card
wide may run as soon as its own card is registered, without waiting for audit_complete

DECIDED 2026-10-26 by the project owner (plan approval): the router is designed on wide, frozen before the first core request and evaluated once on core; its wide figures are design fit
